jobs.occupation: Reliability & Robustness Lead Electromechanical Product Development - 20329
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a senior consultant to lead reliability and robustness activities within a complex electromechanical product development programme involving an external development partner.
You will define evidence-based reliability requirements, assess product risks, establish robustness strategies and drive design improvements through analytical and cross-functional leadership. This is a strategic and hands-on role requiring strong technical expertise, system-level thinking and the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.
What You Will Work On
Define and drive the reliability and robustness strategy for the development programme.
Establish reliability targets, risk assessments and evidence plans.
Develop product usage and exposure profiles.
Lead reliability reviews and design evaluations.
Drive failure investigations, root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Identify critical reliability risks and track mitigation activities.
Evaluate calibration stability, drift mechanisms and service-life considerations.
Collaborate with engineering teams and external development partners on reliability requirements and actions.
Define practical reliability demonstration methods and acceptance criteria.
Support verification planning and reliability-related technical decisions.

What You Bring
At least 10 years of experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Assurance, Systems Engineering or a related discipline.
Proven experience leading reliability activities during product development.
Experience with complex electromechanical products, instruments, equipment or mechatronic systems.
Strong understanding of Design for Reliability (DfR), reliability growth methodologies, failure mode analysis, root cause analysis and risk management.
Experience with verification and validation.
Experience working with suppliers, development partners or outsourced product development organisations.
Ability to influence technical decisions across multiple functions without formal authority.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience in diagnostics, laboratory automation, medical technology or other highly regulated industries.
Experience with capital equipment, robotics, aerospace, semiconductor or advanced manufacturing systems.
Knowledge of Physics of Failure methodologies.
Experience implementing FRACAS and reliability growth programmes.
Experience in reliability testing, life testing and robustness verification.
Experience analysing calibration stability and performance drift.
Experience developing reliability processes, frameworks or organisational capabilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Gameplay Engineer - ARC Raiders
jobs.description:
As a Senior Gameplay Engineer at Embark, you will work on ARC Raiders, alongside some of the most talented people in the games industry. We believe that great games are made in creative environments, where builds are always playable, and teams can move fast and test as many ideas as possible. In close collaboration with our designers, you will create easy-to-use systems that enable us to iterate quickly and that encourage experimentation. 
The games we're making are built in Unreal, using C++, blueprints and a scripting language called Angelscript. This is a technical, systems-oriented role rather than a content-facing one. You will work autonomously across problems like performance, tooling, architecture and networking - the systems our gameplay and design teams build on top of. You won't be planned for gameplay tasks by production; instead you're expected, with some direction, to find and explore solutions to our everyday and long-term technical problems.
Example of responsibilities

Collaborate with a wide range of talents at Embark to deliver ground-breaking technical solutions to create fun gameplay for our players

Identify and build tech to further increase the productivity of our daily work

Assist our team in debugging and fixing complex issues

Take ownership of technical systems across multiple areas of the game - often systems players never interact with directly, but that make everything else possible 

We would love if you have

A creative and curious mind

A strong background in C++

A good grasp of what good gameplay looks and feels like

Fluent in English - our team comes from all over the world!

An interest in computer science and programming as a craft

Experience working across multiple gameplay or engine systems, rather than deep specialization in a single narrow area 

Additionally one or some of these would be a great bonus

Experience with multiplayer

Previously worked with shooter or third-person games

Comfortable owning technical problems end-to-end with minimal day-to-day direction from design or production 

At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

jobs.occupation: We are looking for a DevOps Engineer!
